name: Motional
sub: Hyundai-backed robotaxis riding on Uber in Las Vegas
about: Hyundai-backed robotaxi company that paused and reset after funding pressure. They remain relevant because Hyundai can factory-integrate vehicles and because Uber distribution is still a route to market.
model: Robotaxi operations and potential technology licensing
financing: Hyundai-majority joint venture. Reported $550M Series B in August 2025 led by Aptiv with Hyundai and Nuance Investments, at a reported $6.5B valuation; reported by trade press and private-market data providers rather than a company announcement, so recorded as reported.
deployment: Las Vegas with Uber; other deployments slowed or paused
metrics: IONIQ 5 robotaxis live on Uber in Las Vegas since 13 March 2026 with safety operators aboard, targeting fully driverless late 2026. 130,000+ autonomous rides across prior pilots. Hyundai holds roughly 85% after the May 2024 restructuring ($475M injected, $448M of Aptiv's stake purchased); Aptiv retains about 15%.
signal: Relaunched on Uber in Las Vegas, March 2026, with safety operators aboard; fully driverless targeted late 2026.

sources.title: Uber and Motional Launch Robotaxi Service in Las Vegas
